established: A candidate that is not admitted has a verdict, kept in the report: `PENDING` (an acceptance is missing), `OVERCLAIMED` (wrong filer, wrong basis, order), `MISSING_EVIDENCE`, `UNMET_CONDITION`, `UNVERIFIED` (the basis could not be validated here).
residual: this record cites its witness cases and mutants and does not run them; CI runs the suites and tests/mutants.py before tools/claims.py check
